CAREER OBJECTIVE
PROFILE
PRABHAKARAN RAJENDRAN
SUMMARY & ACHIEVEMENTS
13+ years’ experience in Investment Banking including Settlement & Reconciliation and NAV Pricing operations in various products
Project BLAZE - Migrated TLM reconciliation application to Intellimatch platform for enhanced efficiency- Executed seamless
application migration from TLM reconciliation tool to Intellimatch, streamlining operations and improving accuracy.
Intellimatch Version migration - Developed UAT test cases and validated them for Application Version upgrade across eight databases,
Process ESI (East spring Investment) – New process successfully migrated from Singapore as a pilot batch of cash, securities and MVR
SWIFT feed analysis and issue handling: Work with custodian in case of any issue with related to SWIFT (MT940/950, MT535). Handle
the missing balances in the unknown swift and liaise with custodian to get the required swift feed and perform the reconciliation
PROD readiness of new fund: Ensure to keep the Intellimatch Setup ready for any new account prior to Go-live date and engage with
Transition & Deployment: Actively involving in deployment activities for new Business requirement and perform static setup in
Client Handling: Participate in daily & weekly calls with client & oversight representatives, handling escalations and resolving aged
FA Admin: Handling fund static setup for new fund launch and Manual statement position posting in Winigate application based on
Research and coding outstanding breaks: Perform research for high aged breaks; ensure coding & commenting as per clients. Regular
SOP review & sign off: Ensure SOP documents are reviewed internally on periodic basis and it is shared and approved by client on
Team handling & Work allocation: Managing a team of 8 members and ensure client deliverables are met within deadline without
Other activities: Leave management, identifying training requirement, resource allocation, Issue tracker, Error tracker, Over 3 days
Manage the Change management (BA’s) to understand the Business requirement and provide/Prepare BRD for the development team
Data analysis and data validation/gathering from each level to understand the business actuals and the change expected.
Co-ordinate with users/prod support and suggest them the better and simplest way of developing the reconciliation thereby reducing the
Missing Balances: Ensure the missing balances received due to incorrect swift feeds are cleared on the same day. Liaise with custody
Security Linking: Analyze recon exceptions which not match-off due non-linking of security id or custodian is using the dummy security.
Ensuring the processing of daily money market entries on a multi-currency reporting system under stipulated time periods by the team
Matching of DD debited in our Nostro account and providing to various departments for reversal from payable account.
Managing SWIFT messages (MT103,202 etc) received from banks and corporate on daily basis Reporting to stake holders on account
Perform complete analysis of stocks and portfolios to ensure smooth and timely execution of transitions involving domestic and
Developing and implementing SOPs for improving the operational efficiency of forex vertical Preparing MIS for the top management
Trade confirmation & affirmation with clients and internal stakeholders (Traders, trade assistants) and sharing SSI/MDI details to
Counterparty/Client for instructing trades and Contacting Custodian on status of trades thereby resolving mismatches
Performing Fails investigation on pending trades and ensuring the trades are matched/covered, Also reaching out to desk/Traders for
Escalating the focus trades in a timely basis to client support groups/Sales trader/Traders/Trade assistance thereby providing update on
Pre-matching and settlement of Cross-border settlement– Conversions / ADR Conversions across markets and Instructing dump
Prioritizing prime brokerage, Record date stocks, Focus client and LIFFE (London International Financial Futures and Options
Resolving cross-settlement mismatches by reversing the trades into the market after confirming with cpty and custodian
